Hi Amelia / Evan —

Thanks again for the continued partnership. As we get moving toward your renewal QBR (target week of June 7), the core ask from BlueHealth was a condensed roadmap + hands-on demo that fits into a 60–75 minute window so your execs can join the recap portion.

To keep options flexible we propose a primary slot + two backstops (different timezone coverage) and a named runbook owner for ops handoff. Please pick the slot that works best for your execs and ops:

Primary (preferred)
- Tue Jun 8, 11:00–12:15 ET (08:00–09:15 PT) — compact roadmap walkthrough + 25-min live demo

Backstop A (EMEA-friendly)
- Wed Jun 9, 14:00–15:15 ET (11:00–12:15 PT) — fallback if any execs need afternoon ET

Backstop B (late window)
- Thu Jun 10, 17:30–18:45 ET (14:30–15:45 PT) — allows APAC/EMEA overlap, shorter Q&A

Operational notes and asks:
- Runbook owner (ops/handoff): needs to be assigned — will take on chat coverage and recording permissions.
- Recording: we can record but will keep it private to BlueHealth unless you waive.
- Prework: short prompt set we use in the demo (attached agenda_v1) — please flag any content that must be redacted.

Attachments: renewal_qbr_agenda_v1.pdf (agenda + slide outline), runbook_draft.md (ops checklist, roles).

Next steps: reply with preferred slot (Primary / Backstop A / Backstop B) and who from BlueHealth will be the runbook owner for the day. If none of these work, tell us two 90-minute windows the week of June 7 and we’ll propose alternatives.

Appreciate it —

David
David Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
